name: v0.0.3
body:
# Changes

## Features
- We can now add notes to the board
- Design change yet again
- Ability to change the name of a ref

## Fixes
- Better color algorithm
- Fix the issue that would show up when adding multiple refs

name: v0.0.2
body:
# Changes

### Features
- View your ref with some releveant informations (wip)
- Ability to delete refs
- Ability to tag refs
- Desing change 🎨

### Fixes:
- We can now change the grid size

### Breaking
- The core way the app function has changed, it would be better to re-add all refs
- The board functionality is dead for now, we will  fix it in the next release
